snippet.title: Station Command Gameplay Teaser
snippet.description:
As the new Commander of Watchpoint Station, it's up to you to save the system from ruin in this sci-fi corporate dystopia. Build your fleet of customized ships. Navigate a setting full of secrets and treachery. Command your ships and salvage everything your enemies leave behind.

Demo available now on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3542330/Station_Command/
